channel.title: Journeys In Japan
channel.desc: Across the Ryukyu Islands, you can find elevated sites surrounded by stone walls. The walls protected gusuku or castles built between the 14th and the 15th centuries. Unlike the castles in mainland Japan that emerged in the Sengoku period (15th to 16th centuries), gusuku were also sacred places of community rituals and festivals. Photographer Alfie Goodrich feels the history of Okinawa through exploring these precious ruins.
